ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Advanced Digital Interaction. This advanced studio immerses students in design investigations that stimulate awareness of emergent digital interaction paradigms. Potential areas of exploration include design and development for both mobile devices and interactive environments. Basic proficiency and comfort with HTML, CSS, and a scripting or programming language, as well as access to a laptop computer for every class session, is required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Graduate Section.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Art & Design department.
